instruction.text: What do you think the following expressions mean? Read the example sentences and select the correct answer.

atoms.a: Jared came to me after the fight and apologised. Apparently, he was caught up in the moment and didn’t mean any of the hurtful things he said.
b: ++when someone’s focus is so much on the present moment that they forget the bigger picture
when the present moment and everything else matters
when someone is hooked on what someone else is saying

atoms.a: Minh can’t wait for her birthday party! Since all of her friends don’t know each other yet, she’s thinking of some activities to break the ice.
Jesse has been feeling under the weather pretty often this year. I wonder if they are doing okay.
